frozen_decisions_applied: Plan S5 #13: 'Add production TLS/provisioning key storage interfaces consumed by S6; this stage does not generate untracked production certificates or shared secrets.' -- implemented as typed storage primitives only (get/set per TLS current/next slot, product CA, manufacturing PoP/eFuse record); no rotation, activation, validation or real key/cert material was added, matching both halves of the plan text precisely.

S6's own 'Target artifacts expected absent' list names 'authenticated current/next certificate rotation adapter with atomic active-slot selection' as S6's job, not S5's -- this sub-slice deliberately does not implement slot activation/rollback policy, confirming the stage boundary the plan itself draws.

FD-21's Preserve classification for TLS identity and manufacturing provisioning (Section 2.7, unchanged) was respected by deliberately NOT adding any erase function to this module -- avoiding the exact mistake plan #16/#17's erase enforcement must guard against.

registry_extended.detail: kTlsIdentity gained 5 key patterns (tls_key_cur, tls_key_nxt, tls_cert_cur, tls_cert_nxt, tls_ca) and kManufacturingProvisioning gained 2 (mfg_pop, mfg_efuse_rec); both flipped implemented_today from false to true, consistent with the registry's own documented bar for that flag ('real hal_nvs_* call sites exist today', not 'S6 wires this up end-to-end') -- the same interpretation already applied to kWifiCredentials in the original sub-slice 4 registry. validate_nvs_namespace_registry() (Section 2.7) confirmed no key-pattern collisions were introduced against any existing namespace's patterns.

storage_interface_implemented.detail: tls_identity_get/set_private_key(slot,...), tls_identity_get/set_certificate(slot,...), tls_identity_get/set_product_ca(...), manufacturing_provisioning_get/set_proof_of_possession(...), manufacturing_provisioning_get/set_efuse_record(...) -- each a thin, typed wrapper directly over secure_storage_get_blob/set_blob (Section 2.8/2.9), so namespace-ownership gating and the plan #12 encryption-verified write gate apply automatically with zero new logic of this module's own. No erase function exists in this module (deliberate -- see frozen_decisions_applied).

tests_and_verification.detail: 5 tests in test/host/test_tls_provisioning_storage_port.cpp, all passing, all using synthetic placeholder byte patterns (0xA1/0xB2/0xC3-style filler, never real-looking key/certificate material) -- directly satisfying plan #13's own 'does not generate untracked production certificates or shared secrets' text. Verifies: not-provisioned before any write; current/next private-key slots are genuinely independent (compared directly against each other, not just individually correct); a certificate write is rejected and confirmed absent from storage while encryption is unverified; product CA round-trips once verified; manufacturing PoP and eFuse-record slots are independent of each other.
